## Data Cleaning

Rows with empty cells were removed.

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
data <- read.csv("Most Streamed Spotify Songs 2024.csv")

#Remove rows with empty cells
data[data == ""] <- NA
clean_data <- data %>% drop_na(Track, Album.Name, Artist, Release.Date, ISRC, Spotify.Streams, Spotify.Playlist.Count,  Spotify.Popularity, YouTube.Views, YouTube.Likes, TikTok.Posts, TikTok.Likes, TikTok.Views, YouTube.Playlist.Reach, Explicit.Track)

#Convert strings into numbers
cols <- c("Spotify.Streams", "Spotify.Playlist.Count", "Spotify.Playlist.Reach", "YouTube.Views", "YouTube.Likes", "TikTok.Posts", "TikTok.Likes", "TikTok.Views")

clean_data[cols] <- lapply(clean_data[cols], function(x) {
  x <- gsub(",", "", x)
  as.numeric(x)
})
```
